plan: Deep-copy the recipe and request data on entry so adapt never mutates inputs; print_original simply returns authored_text unchanged.
Scale every ingredient quantity (including component ingredients and later additional ingredients) by Fraction(target_yield)/Fraction(recipe yield) up front.
Index the catalog by target ingredient name, sorting candidates by (priority, original catalog position) so selection is deterministic with catalog order as tie-breaker.

Resolve each ingredient with a while-loop: while its name is excluded, pick the best catalog choice, apply name/quantity_factor/unit/preparation, apply wording_changes to instruction strings, apply equipment additions/removals, accumulate yield_factor, and recursively resolve any additional ingredients through the same exclusions and catalog; a per-chain seen-set detects cycles.

Accumulate failures ('no substitution for NAME', 'substitution cycle involving NAME') in a set and keep processing remaining ingredients so all independently applicable reasons are reported; after substitution, check the final equipment set against available_equipment and add 'equipment NAME unavailable' for each miss.

Handle optional components via a trial copy of the mutable state (instructions, equipment, choices, warnings, reasons): commit on success, otherwise drop the component with a warning instead of failing.

Assemble the result: on failure return recipe=None with sorted reasons and sorted warnings plus choices considered so far; on success rescale by any accumulated yield_factor, set yield to the target, sort equipment, and return sorted warnings, ordered choice IDs, and empty reasons.

Ship an executable acceptance suite under __main__ asserting: 3->5 scaling, chained substitution, wording+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion (both impossible and chained-fix variants), multiple simultaneous reasons, byte-exact original printing with zero input mutation, priority wins and catalog-order tie-break, cycle detection, and optional-component omission.
mechanisms: input deep-copy for non-mutation and exact authored-text preservation
catalog index sorted by (priority, catalog position) for deterministic choice
while-loop chained substitution resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
recursive resolution of substitution-introduced additional ingredients under the same exclusions
literal old->new wording edits applied to instruction strings
set-based exhaustive reason accumulation plus post-substitution equipment availability check
final yield_factor rescale so the output recipe sits exactly at the target yield
